| .op-tip: ETooltip shows its bubble through Reka UI, which mounts it only while it is wanted and places it with floating-ui in the portal target, so the wrapper, the hover and focus-within reveal, the opacity fade and the absolute placement of the reference are gone. .e-tip-bubble keeps the reference look (colour, type, padding, radius, width, centring); it is hoverable, as WCAG 1.4.13 asks, instead of pointer-events: none.

| .op-icon: Moved to .e-icon--glyph: fill and stroke apply only to the built-in filled glyphs, so icons from other sets (stroke icons such as Lucide) keep their own fill and stroke.
| .op-step-dot: The reference sets z-index: 1 on the dot so it sits over the connector line; the library uses the --e-z-raised token (value 1) because raw z-index numbers are not allowed. All other declarations of the rule are kept.
| .op-resizer: The library has no raw z-index numbers (check-css): the token stands in. Stacking inside a heading cell or row only needs to sit above its siblings. The resizer sits inside its heading cell, which is its own stacking context, so z-raised is enough.
| .op-gridtable .op-sticky: The library has no raw z-index numbers (check-css): the token stands in. Stacking inside a heading cell or row only needs to sit above its siblings. Sticky body cells use z-raised (the reference 2); the sticky header cell stays above them with z-sticky.
| .op-filterrow td: The library has no raw z-index numbers (check-css): the token stands in. Stacking inside a heading cell or row only needs to sit above its siblings.
| .op-grid-empty: The reference uses !important to beat .op-table td. Without it the selector is .e-table td.e-grid-empty, which is more specific and has the same effect.
| .op-icongrid: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| .op-icongrid-item: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| .op-icongrid-item .op-icon: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| .op-icongrid-item span: Documentation-only rule of the original icon gallery; the Eos site draws its own icon grid.
| :root: The washes and tokens now come from @eos-ui/tokens (defineTheme().css()), generated from tokens.json; the three color-mix washes are written there.
| .op-input:read-only:not(:disabled): A button also matches :read-only, so the tint landed on every Select trigger. The tint is now keyed on the readonly attribute: .e-input[readonly]:not(:disabled).
| .op-cal-grid td: The day cells keep 3px of room at each side so a selected day does not touch its neighbours or the edges of the grid.
| .op-appt-main: The facts are a child of the grid, so a narrow card can run them the full width under the photo: the column gap stays space-4 and the row gap is space-3. The first row is never shorter than the date tile.
| .op-appt-facts: The facts are a child of the grid, so the rows are spaced by the grid gap instead of a top margin.
| .op-appfooter: The side padding comes from the page column (.e-shell-inner) alone, so the footer text lines up with the header and the content instead of sitting inset by twice the gutter.
